verdict.rationale: Postman's own docs say Spec Hub is used to design an API's structure, which covers spec-first design. The CLI can also lint API schemas and check API specifications against governance rules. Nothing in the evidence names OpenAPI as a supported format or documents exporting a designed spec as OpenAPI, so only about half the story is evidenced. Missing for 10: documented OpenAPI format support in Spec Hub, documented export of specs to OpenAPI files, hands-on or independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can design an API spec-first and export it as OpenAPI

citations.quote: Use Spec Hub to design your API’s structure
Use collections, Spec Hub, and the Postman API to design your API in Postman.
Check API specifications against configured API governance rules.
The Postman CLI enables you to run collections, lint API schemas, run security and governance checks
